test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid testing strategy combining unit, integration, E2E, performance, and security testing. Use Jest for unit and integration tests (Node.js environment), Postman/Newman for API E2E validations, and Locust or k6 for load performance benchmarks. CDC and dual-write validation will use integration tests with test containers for PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Security checks will include SSL/TLS verification, audit logging, and IAM configuration tests. Mock data generators will simulate customer records for multi-country schema validation. Continuous Integration (CI) via GitHub Actions will execute all test suites automatically before staging and production migrations.

test_cases.title: Validate flexible MongoDB schema adaptation per country
test_cases.description: Ensure MongoDB allows addition of new country-specific fields without affecting existing documents.
steps: Insert Japan-specific customer record with 'My Number' field.
Query existing EU and US customer records.
Add new field to EU customer schema (e.g., VAT ID).
test_cases.expected_result: New country-specific fields are stored independently; existing records remain unaffected.

test_cases.title: CDC pipeline ensures <1s lag during dual-write phase
test_cases.description: Verify continuous data updates are replicated from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with sub-second latency.
steps: Insert 100 new records in PostgreSQL.
Monitor MongoDB for replicated entries within 1 second.
Update 10 existing records and measure delta propagation time.
test_cases.expected_result: MongoDB reflects inserts/updates within 1 second of PostgreSQL changes.

test_cases.title: MongoDB index optimization maintains <50ms read latency
test_cases.description: Test that MongoDB queries on indexes return results below 50ms latency (p95).
steps: Execute 5000 read queries per second on indexed fields.
Measure average and p95 latency.
Compare to baseline from PostgreSQL replica.
test_cases.expected_result: Read latency remains under 50ms p95 under load conditions.

test_cases.title: Dual-write successfully commits identical data to both databases
test_cases.description: Ensure write operations insert/update synchronously in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during migration.
steps: POST new customer record via API.
Verify same record exists in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
PUT update to existing record and confirm both updated consistently.
test_cases.expected_result: Identical data persists across both databases with no inconsistency.

test_cases.title: Validate 100% data parity before final cutover
test_cases.description: Ensure all records in PostgreSQL and MongoDB are identical before switching primary source.
steps: Run full parity check script comparing hashes of customer records across databases.
Generate parity report.
Identify discrepancies and validate resolution.

test_cases.title: Rollback procedure restores PostgreSQL within one hour
test_cases.description: Confirm automated rollback disables Mongo writes and resumes full PostgreSQL operation quickly.
preconditions: Rollback script documented and deployed in CI/CD
steps: Trigger rollback workflow via CI/CD job.
Monitor database pointer reversion and data synchronization.
Validate service resumption with PostgreSQL-only writes.
test_cases.expected_result: Rollback completes within 1 hour and PostgreSQL functions as sole data source.

test_cases.title: API backward compatibility validation
test_cases.description: Confirm APIs respond identically pre- and post-migration, with no schema or latency deviation.
preconditions: Feature flag READ_FROM_MONGO toggled to true
steps: Run API regression suite on GET/POST/PUT endpoints.
Compare JSON structure and field values to baseline responses.
Measure latency pre- and post-switch.
test_cases.expected_result: No changes in response structure; latency within <50ms p95 threshold.

test_cases.title: Security and encryption integrity during migration
test_cases.description: Validate secure communication and data protection in migration pipelines.
steps: Run penetration test on MongoDB connection endpoints.
Check encryption at rest status in MongoDB cluster.
Validate CDC logs omit PII data.
test_cases.expected_result: All data transfers encrypted, least-privilege roles applied, CDC logs safe from PII exposure.

test_data_requirements: Synthetic multi-country customer dataset (2M records across 10 countries)
Sample country regulatory fields (VAT ID, My Number, National ID)
Baseline PostgreSQL schema dump for comparison
CDC simulated change events for backfill testing
API call samples for regression (GET, POST, PUT)
automation_approach: Use Jest for automated unit/integration testing across service layer and repositories. Implement Postman/Newman regression suite for API validation integrated in CI/CD. Use Testcontainers to spin up isolated PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments during pipeline builds. Integrate Locust load tests for performance validation as a nightly job. Leverage GitHub Actions or Jenkins to trigger automated rollback E2E tests in staging every sprint end. Use schema validators and snapshot-based comparisons for parity validation automation.
coverage_goals: Achieve >90% unit test coverage in Node.js services, 100% functional coverage on migration and parity validation workflows, full regression coverage on API endpoints (GET, POST, PUT), and >95% reliability validation on CDC latency and dual-write integrity. Ensure all critical paths for migration, rollback, and schema adaptation are tested.
